title: Flexible Column Layout
description: Fiori list-detail-detail layout with up to three columns, resizable separators, responsive column count and the useFlexibleColumnLayout navigation helper.

usage.summary: Show up to three related pages in responsive list, detail and sub-detail columns.
useWhen: Browse a record list, its selected object and a related sub-object while retaining their relationship.
Keep related pages adjacent when space permits: one column at 599px or less, up to two at 600–1023px and up to three at 1024px or more; resized columns stay at least 248px wide.
Use useFlexibleColumnLayout to coordinate navigation levels and full-screen, exit-full-screen and close actions in a custom page composition.

avoidWhen.when: Show noncritical supporting context beside or below one task instead of navigating between related pages.
Start from a complete searchable list, selected detail and sub-detail example.
Read or edit one object across sections without a list-detail navigation hierarchy.
Switch between application sections through vertical navigation.
